verses.text: The LORD was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
“The LORD was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
would have killed us all, because it was furious.
We would have been swept away in a violent flood
Let's praise the LORD! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
The LORD made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
